title: Scanned (image-only) PWS Appendix B building list for an ANG base janitorial contract: 21 printed rows with hand-printed pen-and-ink amendment changes (one row lined out, one SF corrected, one row hand-added, the printed total corrected), UTA frequency codes and cleaning-area-only square footage

sources.note: 168th Wing (Eielson AFB) janitorial services PWS, Attachment 7 to ITB 230000022: "Appendix B, Building Numbers and Estimated Square Footages" table of facility numbers, activities (e.g. MX Fab Shop, MX Hangar, Ops), estimated square footage and weekly frequency; price changes tied to the Appendix B "cleaning area" square footage. Copied: appendix title, column set, activity-abbreviation style, the B.1 modification wording (paraphrased) and the "floor plans provided separately (15 pages)" note.
State of Alaska ITB for the same 168th Wing janitorial services: floor plans for the facilities service areas and estimated square footage attached as a separate file.
Air Force custodial PWS whose Appendix B establishes facility cleaning levels and estimated square footage, with square footage totals used for modification pricing.
Federal RFQ amendment issued to provide per-building square footage (amendments that change the building list are the norm).

provenance.notes: Layout and wording follow the 168th Wing Appendix B (facility no. / activity / estimated sq ft / frequency, cleaning-area modification clause, separate floor plans) and Air Force custodial PWS appendices. Kestrel Air National Guard Base, solicitation W912KS-27-Q-0006, every facility number, activity, floor count, square footage, frequency, the amendment and the initials are illustrative. The pages are full-bleed scans (slight skew, speckle, scanner-edge shadow at the paper edge, staple and staple holes, fax/scan header line, rubber stamp); the pen-and-ink changes are hand-printed ballpoint strokes generated per character with jitter (no typeface). The renderer rasterizes at 110 dpi into an image-only PDF with no text layer; its "Page n of 2" print footer lands on each page as a scan-to-PDF page imprint.

inputs.out: W912KS-27-Q-0006 Att 3 PWS Appendix B Bldg List (conformed thru Amd 0001) - scan.pdf

traps: Image-only PDF: no text layer at all (pages rasterized at 110 dpi, gray, ~0.5° skew in opposite directions on the two pages, speckle noise, scanner-edge shadow, staple mark). The rule-based reader cannot read it; only an OCR / vision reader can.

Pen-and-ink changes are hand-printed capitals drawn as wobbly single ballpoint strokes (per-letter size, slant and baseline jitter), not a typeface, and they ignore the cell grid: corrections overlap cell borders and sit off the printed baselines.
Facility 141 FUELS MANAGEMENT OFFICE (1,240 SF) is lined out by hand with "DELETED – DEMO'D AMD 0001 JRK 2/3/27" and is excluded from truth.
Facility 160 TRAINING / CLASSROOM BUILDING: printed 10,350 is struck through and 11,020 is handwritten above it; truth is 11,020 (Amendment 0001 item B).
Facility 185 SMALL ARMS RANGE CLASSROOM, 1 floor, 1,320 SF, 1X/WK is handwritten into a blank row and is included (Amendment 0001 item C).

TOTAL ESTIMATED CLEANING AREA: the printed 129,545 predates the amendment (it counts 141 and the old 160 value, not 185); it is struck through and 130,295 is handwritten above it (Amendment 0001 item D). 130,295 equals the sum of the 21 in-scope rows, so it is a cross-check; the TOTAL row is not a facility. A reader that reads only the print gets the stale 129,545.
The Amendment 0001 change list (items A–D, "SF 30 BLK 14") is a handwritten note below the table, followed by the contracting officer's signature, "CO" and the date; it is not data rows.

The table breaks across two pages (header repeated, "(continued on page B-2)"); the fax/scan header line, the CONFORMED COPY stamp (overlapping the header line), page labels B-1/B-2 and the "Page n of 2" scan imprint are not data.
Frequency codes: 5X/WK → daily_5, 3X/WK → 3x_week, 2X/WK → 2x_week, 1X/WK → weekly, UTA (one drill weekend per month, B.2) → monthly; "1X/WK + UTA" (106) has no single service level in truth.

The only area column is EST. SQ FT (CLEANING AREA): para B.1 says the square footages are estimates of the areas to be cleaned, and the remarks confirm partial-building service areas (125 office/latrine areas only, hangar floor not included; 135 office & latrines; 140 office, issue counter; 155 admin & latrines only; 110, 115 dining room / common areas). Truth sets cleanableSqft = the stated value on every row, so no category cleanable share is applied on top of it (e.g. hangar 0.25 would turn 4,415 into 1,104). No gross area is given anywhere, so grossSqft carries the same number; the real gross of 125 and other partial buildings is larger but unknown.

Category is left out for 125 (MX hangar), 135 (vehicle maintenance) and 140 (supply warehouse): the serviced area is offices, latrines, break room and issue counter, so the hangar / maintenance / warehouse category (concrete floor mix, no break-room service) would misdescribe the space actually cleaned.
Asterisk after facility 125 name refers to a note below the table.
